div.div:
One canonical ticket per unit; buyer and recipient are distinct.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
order_item_id: uuid [FK UQ NN]
recipient_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
status: text [NN]
default 'valid'
qr_token_hash: text [UQ NN]
token_version: integer [NN]
default 1
claimed_at: timestamptz [?]
issued_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
pdf_file_id: uuid [FK ?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (order_item_id)
UQ2: (qr_token_hash)
UQ3: (id, event_id)
UQ4: (id, event_id, recipient_user_id)
CK1: status IN ('valid','checked_in','refund_pending','refunded','cancelled')
CK2: token_version > 0
CK3: (recipient_user_id IS NULL) = (claimed_at IS NULL)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(order_item_id, event_id) -> order_item(id, event_id) [1 parent / 0..1 children]
(recipient_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(pdf_file_id) -> stored_file(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Expiring claim challenge; intended email comes from immutable order item.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
ticket_id: uuid [FK NN]
token_hash: text [UQ NN]
expires_at: timestamptz [NN]
consumed_at: timestamptz [?]
consumed_by_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
revoked_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (token_hash)
CK1: expires_at > created_at
CK2: (consumed_at IS NULL) = (consumed_by_user_id IS NULL)
PARTIAL UQ: (ticket_id) WHERE consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(ticket_id) -> ticket(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(consumed_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Short-lived signed-in attendee proof; separate from printed ticket identity.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
ticket_id: uuid [FK NN]
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
attendee_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
session_id: uuid [FK NN]
token_hash: text [UQ NN]
signing_key_id: text [NN]
expires_at: timestamptz [NN]
consumed_at: timestamptz [?]
revoked_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (token_hash)
UQ2: (id, ticket_id, event_id)
CK1: expires_at > created_at
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(ticket_id, event_id, attendee_user_id) -> ticket(id, event_id, recipient_user_id) [1
parent / 0..* children]
(session_id, attendee_user_id) -> auth_session(id, user_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
